title: NY State Assembly · District 53
area: North Brooklyn, including Bushwick and Williamsburg.

context.text: Uncontested race. Incumbent Maritza Davila (D), first elected in 2012, is running unopposed on the November 3, 2026 general-election ballot; no other candidate qualified for the Republican, Conservative or other party lines.

candidates.name: Maritza Davila

summary.text: Maritza Davila is the incumbent Democratic nominee for NY State Assembly District 53, running unopposed for a seventh term. A longtime Bushwick and Williamsburg community organizer, she chairs the Assembly's Social Services Committee and is a member of the Puerto Rican/Hispanic Task Force.

background.text: Born in Catano, Puerto Rico, and moved to Bushwick, Brooklyn, as a young girl, where she has lived since; raised three children as a single mother in Bushwick.

Began her public-service career as a community organizer on education, healthcare, public safety, affordable housing and economic-development issues in Bushwick and Williamsburg, and served as president of the Community School District 32 board of education.
Was a founding member of the North Brooklyn Coalition Against Domestic Violence and founded the Northern Brooklyn Residents Association, a community advocacy group focused on affordable housing.
Joined the Ridgewood Bushwick Senior Citizens Council in 1996, where she helped found a local credit union and organized tenant, merchant and block associations.
Earned an associate's degree in Political Science from Long Island University in 2013.

record.text: Chairs the Assembly's Social Services Committee (since January 2023) and is a member of the Alcoholism and Drug Abuse, Children and Families, Housing and Rules committees in the 2025–2026 session; also a member of the Assembly's Puerto Rican/Hispanic Task Force.

Sponsors legislation on public assistance and rent-regulated housing, including A02502 (establishing home stability support supplement programs), A02538 (barring SNAP applicants from being required to submit to finger imaging) and A00989 (regulating buyout agreements within rent-regulated apartments); as of the current session these remained in committee without floor votes.

candidates.researchNotes: Davila has not completed a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey and no 2026 campaign website with dated issue statements could be located; positions are left empty rather than inferred, and her record draws on her official Assembly biography, committee roles and legislative record.
